test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'popular'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the passage reveals that pizza is not a traditional Indian dish nor a standard part of the diet, which can eliminate options 1 and 3.
 
• Pizza is also not a staple food in India, so option 2 is not applicable here.
 
• The term '**popular**' completes the meaning of the sentence and blends well with the overall context showing a newfound love for pizza by the Indians in recent times.

Conclusion: Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• During the last few decades, with globalization and the exposure to Western culture, fast food items such as pizza have become increasingly popular in India.
